description: Icon mapping using lucide icon names (available via lucide-react, and lucide's SVG set works fine embedded directly in Streamlit/HTML if not using React). One icon per panel, one per health status, one per power source — kept minimal and functional, not decorative.

power_source_icons.note: Maps to active_power_source values in simulation/states.json — shown as a small badge on the Mission Profile panel timeline.

mission_phase_icons.note: Matched loosely by keyword against phase_name in missions/*.json; falls back to 'circle-dot' for any unmatched phase name (e.g. 'Delivery', 'Survey Grid').

usage_notes: Keep icons at size_px_default everywhere except metric_hero contexts, where they may scale to 28px max — never larger, this is a data dashboard, not a marketing page.
Status and power-source icons always pair with their color_ref token from colors.json — never rely on color alone (accessibility) or icon alone (scan speed); use both together.
